adjudicatedDivergence.resolutionFactVerbatim: The DFT.csv row carries a legacy copy of the same test (Hardware_initial vset[vbat,4.2,100e-6,0] + vset[amux,1,100e-6,0]; Software_initial I2CWriteSameData(0x56,0x22)), while the governing workbook OVERVIEW row 7, dali_tm_meta.json and reg_config/tm103.sv all specify vset[vbat,4,...] + field[(EN_ATEST0,1),(ATEST0_MUX,4)] + vset[vdm,1,...].
adjudicatedDivergence.resolutionHandlingVerbatim: Do not use the copied DFT.csv Hardware_initial/Software_initial fields as stimulus, route or register authority. VBAT=4 V, VDM=1 V and EN_ATEST0=1/ATEST0_MUX=4 (0x57=0x02, 0x5E=0x04) govern. The current implementation in test.cpp already follows the governing values.
adjudicatedDivergence.resolutionScopeVerbatim: This resolution adjudicates only the DFT source contradiction. Relay and instrument selection remain the strategy architect's job and must use project schematic/CBIT evidence.
adjudicatedDivergence.handlingByThisRole: Recorded verbatim as evidence. The adjudication was not re-opened, the retired flat export was not modified or moved, nothing was silently corrected, and this divergence is not a blocking item.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: The retired row's executed statement I2CWriteSameData(DEV_ADDR, 0x56, 0x22) contradicts its own trailing comment field[(EN_ATEST0,1),(ATEST0_MUX,4)] inside the same cell.
nonBlockingObservations.classification: internal inconsistency of the already-adjudicated legacy copy
nonBlockingObservations.reasoning: Both the stale write and the field intent sit inside the single retired Software_initial cell, and the adjudication already rules which side governs (the field intent, 0x57=0x02 / 0x5E=0x04). No separate contradiction is opened.
